HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   B. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   D. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.
   D. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
